entities.name: Johannes Grubenmann
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Johannes Grubenmann was a member of the Swiss Grubenmann family who were known as carpenters and civil engineers in the eighteenth century. He specialized in constructing church towers, turret clocks and bridges.
